Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists Hinds Energy Facility, plant 55218, generators H01, H02 and H03 as operating, each with an operating year of 2001.
